name: Grave of Voices
storyline:
A horror explorer and YouTuber receives a strange email about a forgotten town near his apartment. Out of curiosity he decides to check out the place if it’s worth a video. But the moment he steps through the gate, the exit disappears. Trapped inside a town swallowed by time, he has to find another exit.

The streets are quiet, too quiet. Whispers runs through his mind, and sometimes, shadows seem to follow. Every corner hides traces of a story buried deep old bones, broken skeleton, and signs of something that was never meant to be found.
summary:
This is a first-person survival horror game focused on atmosphere, exploration, and tension. You’ll search for clues, solve environmental puzzles, and scavenge resources to survive. There is no signal and your phone is useless. Every step forward could reveal something vital or something hunting you.

Hide when you can. Fight when you must. Explore the catacombs in order to escape this messed up place. But the deeper you go the more your brain becomes messed up.

Will you escape… or end up as just another set of bones beneath the city?
